question: LeWM 的 prediction target 分支、prediction context 分支和 SIGReg 分别推动门规则配对未来收缩还是分离？

balanced_batch.source: frozen diagnostic observed-passable/passable-target and observed-blocked/blocked-target pairs

sign_convention: predicted_distance_change_per_unit_lr < 0 means an infinitesimal gradient-descent step contracts the paired door-rule distance; > 0 means expansion.

gradient_partition_contract.pred_context_branch: target embedding detached; gradients follow the prediction and context path
gradient_partition_contract.pred_target_branch: prediction detached; gradients follow only the online target representation path
gradient_partition_contract.note: The branch entries are gradient views of the same scalar MSE, not two scalar terms to add.
